jobs.title: Creative Director (Remote US)
jobs.description:
About Legion

Let’s be real, AI isn’t magic; Legion was built to move beyond AI hype—delivering secure, reliable systems that work alongside the people tackling the world’s most critical challenges.

Born from a Department of Defense partnership and trusted by leaders across government and enterprise, Legion embeds intelligence inside complex systems, unlocking data, accelerating human workflows, and strengthening mission-critical systems. We don’t replace workflows—we optimize them, ensuring quality, efficiency, and reliability inside the platforms our partners already use.

With world-class collaborators like Palantir, Nvidia, HPE, and Oracle, we’re building intelligent infrastructure that enhances human capability and drives impact at the edge and across a range of enterprises.

We’re looking for bold thinkers and doers to join us in shaping the future of AI that’s secure, grounded, and built to work.

Creative Director (Remote US)

***You will set the creative bar in, brand design, art direction, or creative services, in high-growth technology, AI, B2B SaaS, or similarly complex and technical markets***

***Required: A link to your online portfolio or a PDF upload of your work samples is required to be considered for this role. (see options below to provide link or upload***

The Role

Legion produces a steady and growing stream of creative across brand, demand, product, web, social, video, and events. We are bringing that creative capability in-house and closer to the team, and rebuilding it as an AI-native creative function, while keeping our agency partner for the largest and most specialized bets. As Creative Director, you are the hands-on operating core of that function: the senior creative who sets the bar, ships the work, and builds the prompts, templates, and playbooks that let a lean team produce like a much larger one.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role to start, a player-coach who makes the work. You will report to the SVP of Marketing and partner first across the marketing team, including Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, and PR. You will work closely with the Product team on product design direction and in-product visuals, and with GTM and Sales on enablement and customer-facing materials. You will build and manage a small flex bench of designers and specialists over time, with limited contractor support to start.

Why This Role Matters

Legion’s work spans national security, defense, intelligence, the public sector, critical infrastructure, and the national research labs, work that often matters most where it cannot be discussed. The creative function you build is how that mission becomes legible to the people who need to understand it. You will be building the creative infrastructure that lets Legion tell a hard, important story at the speed the moment demands.

Legion is a remote-first company and an equal opportunity employer. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a culture built on ownership, discipline, and mission. To apply, submit your resume along with a portfolio or work samples.

You will work at two levels at once

At the craft level, setting the creative bar and personally shipping the highest-priority brand, campaign, product, and web work.At the systems level, building the machine-readable brand, prompts, and AI-native workflows that make on-brand speed the default for the whole team.The way we build for customers is the way you will build here: a human sets intent, AI does the heavy lifting, and a human approves what ships. This is a builder’s seat, not a brand-police seat. If you want to define how a modern, AI-native marketing team creates, ships, governs, and scales creative work, this is that role.

What You Will Own

Creative Direction and Hands-On Execution

Set the creative bar across brand, web, campaigns, events, social, video, and sales materials, and personally design and produce the highest-priority work. This is a hands-on role first, a player-coach who still makes the work.Translate complex AI, agent orchestration, edge, and national security concepts into clear, credible visual systems.Campaign and Go-to-Market Creative

Partner with Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, and Product Marketing on demand generation, ABM, launches, education, and field events.Build modular campaign systems, landing pages, social assets, email graphics, sales collateral, and executive materials that scale across channels and audiences.AI-Native Creative Systems

Use frontier models and AI creative tools daily to build repeatable workflows that compound over time, across video, campaign kits, landing pages, social, product visuals, and decks.Turn Legion’s brand into machine-readable infrastructure: reusable prompts, templates, kits, and playbooks, with human review at the brief and the final gate, plus clear guardrails for AI tooling, IP, and brand safety.Creative Operations and the Flex Bench

Build and manage a flexible bench of freelance designers, motion and video specialists, and other contractors from the ground up, deploying them for surges and specialty work as demand grows.Own intake, prioritization, briefs, review rituals, and clear SLAs from brief to first concept to shipped asset.Product Design Support

Partner with the Product team to help set visual design direction that brings the product in line with the Legion brand, raising the baseline polish of apps, Spaces, and features so the product looks as credible as it is capable.Oversee and produce product and in-product visual support: icons, diagrams, app imagery, feature visuals, and lightweight in-product creative.Performance and Measurement

Run creative as a measurable loop, from brief to shipped asset to performance read to the next iteration, in close partnership with Demand Marketing and Marketing Operations.Use performance signals to sharpen concepts, formats, and priorities, without letting short-term optimization ero

jobs.title: Creative Director, Paid Social (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About The Role

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Director of Paid Social to own end-to-end creative across our Health vertical, a portfolio that today includes weight loss medications, hair loss, hearing, TRT, and dating. You will concept, write, direct, and supervise editorial on the paid social and native creative that drives acquisition for Forbes and its partners, and you will lead a pod of creatives doing the same. This is a direct-response storyteller's role layered with creative management responsibility.

The role reports into the VP Creative and partners with our Paid Social and Native Buyers, who direct the spend, and vertical General Managers, who own category outcomes.

The successful candidate is a senior creative leader. You are fluent in the modern direct-response canon, comfortable in regulated health categories, and produce video and copy at performance-marketing pace without sacrificing craft. You have built and led creative teams before, and you can run a small team of senior individual contributors (creative leads and editors) and personally taking on high priority projects yourself. You move fluently across content modes (remote UGC, in-studio and on-location shoots, AI-generated content) and pick the right mode for pipeline needs. Above all, you are equally at home concepting on a page, directing on set, supervising an edit, and reviewing your team's work with sharp, useful notes.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to accelerate output without diluting craft, and you will be expected to operate that way from day one. You can articulate where AI sharpens video storytelling and where it weakens it. In short, AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You already use it to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

Responsibilities



Own end-to-end creative for the Health vertical: concept, copy, direction, post, and the operating system(s) that produces it.Lead the Health creative pod (Creative Leads, editors, producers). Hire, develop, and raise the bar across the team. Partner with the VP Creative on org design as the team grows.Concept new storytelling angles and write or supervise scripts from blank page to final cut across paid social and native video. Stay hands-on for hero or category-defining work.Produce across the full range of content modes the vertical demands: remote UGC, in-studio and on-location shoots, and AI-generated content. Match production mode to pipeline needs.Direct documentary-style, on-camera interviews with doctors, telehealth providers, patients, and UGC creators. Coach others on the team to direct interviews to the same bar.Collaborate with editors from pre-production through delivery. Own the cut on hero work, supervise the rest.Analyze performance data and use it to drive incremental and step-change creative optimizations that scale.Work fluently inside compliance rails (FDA-style health claims, regulated category guardrails, partner overlays). Keep persuasion and compliance aligned rather than in tension.Provide regular updates on creative performance, hiring, and craft initiatives to the Creative leadership team and to Health vertical stakeholders.Available to travel to locations to film, gather footage, and conduct interviews.

Requirements

10+ years of direct-response creative experience in performance-driven environments (supplements, health, telehealth or comparable), with at least 3 years in a creative management role.Demonstrated experience leading and growing a creative team of 5+ individual contributors across writing, directing, and post.Portfolio of video ads with clear performance attribution. We want to see the actual work and hear the actual results, including work your team produced under your direction.Mastery of direct-response narrative architecture: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, transition, offer, and CTA. Working command of the modern direct-response canon.AI-augmented creative fluency. Regular use of AI tools across ideation, scripting, and post. Production fluency across multiple content modes: remote UGC at volume, in-person studio and location shoots, and AI-generated or AI-assisted content. You can pick the right mode for the brief.Strong on-set craft. You can run a shoot yourself, direct non-actor talent, and hold the bar from concept through final cut.Editorial voice fluency. You can direct an interview that feels like a real conversation and shape a story that feels like a story, not a sales letter shot on camera.Demonstrated speed and volume in performance marketing environments. Comfortable shipping multiple cuts and tests a week across multiple categories and iterating from data.Comfort working inside compliance rails (FDA-style health claims, regulated health category language, partner brand guardrails).Strong collaboration skills across Creative, Buying, vertical GMs, Editorial, Brand, and Legal.Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment.Excellent communication and organizational skills.

Strong Pluses

Direct experience with GLP-1, weight loss, hair loss, telehealth, or comparable regulated health DR categories.Quiz funnel and branching-narra

jobs.title: Creative Director, Art (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
About VIVO
VIVO is a healthcare marketing agency specializing in consumer health, pharma, and medtech. We are a 100% remote agency with team members all around the US. Being 100% remote means we value constant collaboration, clear communication, personal accountability, and proactive problem solvers.
At VIVO, we believe health is more than a sector; it’s a life-changing mission. We are creators and strategists driven to make healthcare impactful and accessible, from first impressions to lifelong connections. We bring insight, curiosity, and compassion to every project, knowing our work helps patients, doctors, and everyone in between get the care they deserve—when and where it’s needed most. We’re here to challenge the norms and elevate health brands to inspire, engage, and transform lives.


About You
VIVO is a growing independent healthcare agency with ambitious plans for what comes next—and we believe exceptional creative will be central to getting us there.
We’re looking for a Creative Director — Art who can raise our creative bar, lead and grow our Art discipline, and help shape the future of Creative at VIVO.


This is a senior leadership role for someone who is as passionate about building as they are about making: building exceptional work, talented teams, strong creative partnerships, better ways of working, and an agency people notice.


You’ll bring deep roots in art and design, but your creative thinking should extend well beyond the visual. You understand how art, copy and strategy come together to create an idea, and you're comfortable helping lead multidisciplinary teams toward work that's strategically smart, beautifully executed and impossible to ignore.


What You Will Do
Set the Creative Bar.

Own and elevate the visual and creative standard across VIVO's client and agency work.
Lead the development of integrated ideas across digital, social, video, print, experiential and emerging channels.
Be hands-on when it matters—reviewing, challenging, refining and elevating work from concept through execution.
Push healthcare creative beyond the expected and help build a body of work that earns attention from clients, talent and our industry.

Lead Art. Influence Creative.

Lead, mentor and develop VIVO's Art and Design talent, creating clarity around expectations, feedback, growth and accountability.
Partner closely with our Creative Director, Copy to create a highly integrated creative organization where Art and Copy make one another better.
Think beyond your own discipline. Bring a strong point of view to concepts, storytelling, creative strategy and the overall quality of our work.
Evolve the structure, capabilities and future of VIVO's Creative department.

Build, Don't Just Maintain.

Identify the talent, capabilities, processes and tools we need for our next stage of growth.
Develop creative leaders—not just great campaigns.
Create an environment where talented people are challenged, supported and able to do the best work of their careers.
Partner Across the Agency.
Work closely with Strategy, Client Services, Project Management, Editorial and Agency Leadership to turn business problems into powerful, creative solutions.
Build trust across disciplines and eliminate the silos that get in the way of great work.
Be someone our teams want in the room for our most important opportunities and our toughest creative challenges.

Help Grow VIVO.

Play a meaningful role in new business, pitches and organic client growth.
Present ideas and creative vision confidently to senior clients.
Identify opportunities to make our existing client work stronger—and our relationships bigger.
Help build VIVO's external creative reputation through award-worthy work, thought leadership and visibility in the industry.

Embrace What's Next.

Bring curiosity—not fear—to emerging technology.
Help us integrate AI and new tools thoughtfully into concepting, design, content development and production while protecting originality, craft and quality.

What You Bring

15+ years of creative experience with deep roots in art direction/design
Significant experience as a Creative Director, Group Creative Director, or equivalent
A portfolio demonstrating exceptional conceptual thinking and visual craft
Strong network of talent and vendor relationships
Experience leading integrated work across art, copy and multiple channels
A track record of building and developing creative talent
The ability to move between big-picture creative vision and hands-on creative direction
Strong executive presence and confidence presenting to senior clients
Experience contributing to pitches, new business and organic growth
Healthcare, pharma, life sciences, diagnostics, medical device or health-tech experience strongly preferred
AI experience and a strong philosophy about how to integrate it across our agency

But the most important thing is how you think. You're a builder. You care about developing people as much as developing ideas. You have high standards without needing to have all the answers yourself. You know the best creative departments aren't built around one person's ego—they're built around talented people who challenge one another and make the work better together. And you're excited by the opportunity to help shape what VIVO becomes next.
What We Bring
VIVO offers an award-winning culture and comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, financial well-being, professional growth, and work-life balance. Our benefits offerings include:

Medical, dental, vision
Company paid disability & life insurance
401k with match up to 6%
Annual wellness stipend
Professional development allowance
Recognition, rewards, prizes and amazing swag
11 Holidays plus Winter Break and Annual In-Person Retreat
3+ weeks of total paid time off in Year 1

Ask our hiring manager and/or HR team for more information about any or all of our benefits.

 You’ll lead creative direction across all four brands at once – brand identity, digital, social, e-commerce, packaging, retail and campaigns – owning both strategy and execution. That breadth is the point: rather than one brand or a seat in a large department, you’d shape all of it.
   
 You’ll direct product launches and major brand moments from concept through delivery, managing day-to-day creative priorities, workflow and timelines across a lean team of around 30 people, mentoring two direct reports managing external creative partners, and working closely with brand, marketing, product, e-commerce and leadership.

This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. jobs.title: Associate Creative Director – Core Brand
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 



Job Description

The ServiceNow Brand & Strategy team is a passionate team of creative thinkers responsible for shaping the future of the ServiceNow brand. We are looking for an Associate Creative Director to contribute to the vision for the ServiceNow brand and drive design excellence across the organization—across every channel and touchpoint, internal and external. 

This role is responsible for executing and evolving the ServiceNow brand identity, contributing to a design-led vision across ServiceNow’s brand ecosystem globally, and standing up systems designed to scale with AI. The ideal candidate has a passion for craft with meticulous attention to execution and a sharp understanding of how to build for enterprise application. They have experience leading projects with internal teams, freelancers, and external agencies—and thrive in ambiguity. 

The Associate Creative Director will raise the creative bar, contribute to an inclusive and collaborative design culture, and partner seamlessly across the ServiceNow organization. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is curious about technology, can build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships, and brings both strategic thinking and hands-on craft to their work from initial briefing through to final delivery. 

Responsibilities:

Contribute to the global brand identity for ServiceNow products and services, ensuring quality, consistency, and scalability across all touchpoints 

Deliver strategic brand systems that serve a global audience and are designed to scale using AI 

Support and strengthen brand design culture through enabling world-class design 

Apply rigorous ways of working to improve performance, quality, and integrated approaches to execution 

Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Business partners to contribute to holistic brand systems 

Work closely with the Brand Design Director and Executive Creative Director, and cross-functional partners to ensure design work is strategic and drives business objectives 



Qualifications

6–9 years of experience in design, with meaningful exposure to building consumer or enterprise brands Experience leading with creative vision, purpose, and a commitment to craft 

Experience developing brand directions that solve business problems 

Experience working within brand architecture and portfolio brand systems 

Exposure to integrated design work across traditional, digital, and experiential channels 

Experience managing and collaborating with internal teams, freelancers, and external agencies 

Strong ability to collaborate and drive alignment across highly cross-functional teams 

Exceptional communication skills—able to present work clearly and confidently from strategy to execution 

Experience partnering with and influencing marketing and creative leadership 

Expert with creative tools including Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma 

Experience in photo art direction a plus 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $148,400 - $259,700, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.



Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals.
